# Southern Living

> > Southern Living is the definitive guide to Southern cuisine, hospitality, gardening, and lifestyle, featuring reader-voted awards, classic recipes, and regional travel destinations.

Southern Living celebrates the culture and traditions of the American South through tested recipes, home and garden advice, and annual reader rankings of the region's best hotels and restaurants. The magazine highlights destinations across North Carolina, South Carolina, Florida, Georgia, and Texas while preserving Southern cooking heritage and hospitality.

## Key Topics

- Southern cooking and comfort food
- Classic Southern recipes
- Holiday baking and desserts
- Southern hospitality and dining
- Regional travel destinations (Charleston, Savannah, North Carolina)
- Reader-voted awards for hotels and restaurants
- Home gardening and lawn care
- Seasonal celebrations and Easter traditions
- Vegetarian and meatless cooking
- Recipe collections
- Southern ingredients (mozzarella, wild rice, collards)
- Kitchen tips and cleaning advice
- Slow-cooker and easy recipes
- Vintage and nostalgic Southern traditions
